parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Design intent of Node 1: V-001 separates the incoming production stream by density into gas (fuel gas, with excess to the burn pit), oil (to the Heater–Treater, then V-003) and free water (to water treatment) at a nominal 60 psig/130 °F [SYS-01 to SYS-05]. The source elements (Pressure, Flow, Level, Temperature, Corrosion/Erosion, Start/Stop) were combined with the No/More/Less/Reverse/Another/Fire-Explosion/Error guidewords [SYS-07, SYS-08]. This was applied across the vessel, E-001, the inlet, all three outlets and the listed instruments. The highest-priority deviations are: (1) V-001 overpressure from blocked gas or liquid outlets, PV-101 failure, inlet surge, fire or start-up line-up, relying on PSV-101 A/B whose set pressure and sizing basis cannot be verified against an inconsistent pressure basis; (2) loss of level causing gas blow-by into the Heater–Treater and water treatment; (3) fire/explosion from loss of containment, external fire and burn-pit operation; and (4) high level causing liquid carryover to fuel gas and the burn pit. The single source-supported human/procedural item, start-up without bypass opening [SYS-09], is kept as a distinct procedural finding. Interface, temperature/E-001, reverse-flow, instrumentation-error and corrosion/erosion deviations complete the boundary coverage. Because safeguards are known only by tag [SYS-06], recommendations prioritise verification of the relief basis, independent pressure and level protection, SDV cause-and-effect, E-001 definition, corrosion monitoring and a verified start-up procedure. Organizational factors remain unresolved.
